subject: Exec workshop ground-transport & driver credentialing
messages:
From: Acme Events <events@acmeworkshops.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.cole@enterpriseclient.com
Date: 2028-05-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Need curb/staging design + driver credentialing for 05/22 exec workshop

Hi Jasmine / Lauren,

Quick one as we finalize the site logistics for Acme Systems' executive workshop on 22 May. Venue has two curb access points (North Loading and South Porte) and the client wants a tight arrival window between 08:30–09:15. They also require verified driver credentials and a simple on-site badge for drivers that we'll collect at check-in.

Could Redwood provide:
- A curbside marshalling plan (which door for which cohort + buffer times)
- A short driver credentialing checklist we can attach to the vendor contract
- A one-page driver arrival card (staging code + phone + pass ID) that we can hand to drivers

Sarah from Acme is copied. We can iterate but need the first draft by EOD Friday so we can send to facilities/security.

Thanks — looking forward to the draft.

Best,
Meg Lawson
Event Producer, Acme Events
Acme Systems Workshop Ops

Attachments: none

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: events@acmeworkshops.com, sarah.cole@enterpriseclient.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-04T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need curb/staging design + driver credentialing for 05/22 exec workshop

Meg / Sarah —

Thanks — drafting now. High-level plan below; attaching the ride_manifest_v1.csv with provisional pickup windows and the curb-pass-template.pdf for driver badges.

Plan summary (draft):
- Marshall points:
  - North Loading (Door A) — VIP arrivals (CEO + leadership), 08:30–08:45 window. Driver staging code: NORTH-VIP-01. Drivers to report to North marshal (Tessa, onsite coordinator) for immediate escorted entry.
  - South Porte (Door B) — Attendee shuttles and car services, 08:40–09:15 staggered windows every 5–7 minutes. Staging code: SOUTH-SHUT-01.
- Parking pass pickup: drivers will receive a single-use curb pass handed out by our security desk at Gate 2. The pass template is attached. We will pre-print 40 passes and hold them in a zip folder at Gate 2.
- Driver credential checklist (one-liner items we want in vendor contract):
  1) Government-issued photo ID on arrival (scanned copy uploaded to vendor portal 24h prior).
  2) Vehicle license plate and VIN on manifest.
  3) Insurance certificate on file (minimum $1M liability).
  4) Background check attestation (within past 24 months) or company letter of liability.
  5) Driver phone + emergency contact.
- Onsite process:
  - Drivers check in at Gate 2 (security) and receive one curb pass (valid for single entry).
  - Marshals at Door A/B will call drivers 1 minute before curb release; drivers will be waved in by security.
  - Excess arrivals go to overflow lot (Lot C) and will be routed to an official shuttle queue at South Porte.
- Contingencies:
  - If a driver lacks ID, they will not be admitted. Marcus — we will need a discretionary check-in exception log if client escalates.
  - For rideshare surge: we will allow rideshare drop at South Porte but block pickup for 30 minutes post-event to minimize curb conflict.

Next steps requested from Acme:
- Confirm count of VIP vehicles (we have placeholder 6).
- Approve staging codes and Gate 2 as credential collection point.
- Provide vendor list you intend to use so we can pre-authorize drivers (BlueLine included?).

I will route a vendor addendum template (redlines included) to the vendor next for signatures — attaching vendor_contract_redline.pdf for reference.

— Jasmine Liu
Events Ops, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: ride_manifest_v1.csv, curb-pass-template.pdf, vendor_contract_redline.pdf

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, events@acmeworkshops.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-05T11:02:00-07:00

Thanks Jasmine — solid start. A few follow-ups from facilities/security:
- We need a vendor driver roster with photo IDs 72 hours prior (so latest by 05/19 09:00 PDT). BlueLine should provide a scanned roster PDF with names, driver license numbers (redacted on the copy we store) and vehicle plates.
- Please add a short line for on-site marshal radio channel and the onsite contact numbers (we'll put those on the driver card).
- For the VIP lane (Door A): we prefer drivers wait in a holding bay 10 minutes before the release. Can you add a queueing order to the manifest so marshals can call vehicles in exact sequence?

Meg / Sarah — can you confirm that BlueLine (or your preferred car service) can provide the roster and meet the 05/19 deadline? If not, we will require an alternative pre-approved vendor.

Also, a quick note — for any driver exceptions we plan to collect an "Exception Log" signed by the Redwood onsite manager. This allows us to track escalations if a driver arrives without full docs.

Marcus Lin
Head of Workplace Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0422
